Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Thanks for contributing!
However, for clarity:
1/ the subject title should be the "TWD - <the event name>", not "Contributing to the TWD"
2/ the green tick shouldn't be set, otherwise the TWD will not be processed (as the green tick is used to mark TWD that have already been processed)

Could you fix your post? Thanks!

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
